HOMEPAGE.PART1TITLE: Enjoy the best aesthetic services at home
HOMEPAGE.PART1TEXT: Our qualified professionals come to your home to provide you with high-quality beauty care, tailored to your needs and desires. Experience a unique wellness experience, whether it's during your lunch break, after work, in the evening, or during an afternoon with friends.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TITLE: Work when you want, earn custom revenue
HOMEPAGE.PART2TEXT: Generate income according to your own schedule by accepting requests on the platform, at your own pace. You can use your own equipment or choose to rent professional equipment through izyGlam.
HOMEPAGE.PART3TITLE: A beauty service, reimagined for businesses
HOMEPAGE.PART3TEXT: Glam for Business is a platform dedicated to companies of all sizes, designed to manage the aesthetic needs of your clients and employees. Offer personalized beauty care directly at the workplace, during corporate events or for special occasions. Our qualified professionals travel to provide services tailored to your needs.
